name: Sinful Thoughts
overview: Scripture reveals that sinful thoughts originate from the heart and mind, influencing actions and defiling the individual (Matthew 15:19; Mark 7:20). Jesus teaches that even lustful intent in the heart is equivalent to adultery, emphasizing the seriousness of internal sin (Matthew 5:28). Believers are called to diligently guard their hearts and minds, renewing them in Christ to discern and live out God’s perfect will (Proverbs 4:23; Romans 12:2). When the mind is fixed on God, He grants perfect peace, highlighting the transformative power of focused trust and thought (Isaiah 26:3).
